newsitem.title: ISRAEL: RESEARCH ALERT - Tadiran Telecom estimate raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Tadiran Telecom estimate raised.

text.p: Lehman Brothers reiterated its 1-Buy rating for Tadiran Telecommunications Ltd and raised its earnings estimate for 1997 to $1.71 a share from $1.66.
This follows the conclusion of negotiations on a major supply agreement with Bezeq Israel Telecom, the state-controlled phone monopoly.

"We are encouraged that Tadiran Telecom succeeded last week in signing a memorandum of understanding with Israel's telephone service provider ahead of our expected timetable, removing uncertainty concerning a core customer relationship," Lehman said in a report.
"We consider that a forthcoming definitive agreement is likely to lead to price reductions at the lower end of our expected range, while providing pricing stability until the end of the decade."
Lehman said Tadiran Telecom was trading at a substantial discount to its closest peers.
Tadiran Telecom is a subsidiary of Tadiran Ltd, Israel's largest electronics company.
